board.name: ESP32-WROOM-32 DevKit v1
board.notes: Do not feed more than 3.3 V into any GPIO. Use a divider on 5 V sensor outputs.

constraints.forbidden_reason: Wired to the on-board SPI flash. Using these bricks the board.
constraints.input_only_reason: These pins have no output driver and no internal pull-ups.
constraints.strapping_reason: Their level at boot selects the flash/boot mode. Safe as inputs or short-lived outputs, risky as a pin that must be HIGH at power-on.
constraints.uart0_reason: Reserved for the USB serial monitor.
constraints.adc2_reason: ADC2 is unavailable while Wi-Fi is active. Use ADC1 pins (32-39) for analog reads when Wi-Fi is on.

parts.purpose: Runs the generated firmware and streams telemetry over Wi-Fi/USB serial.
Drives the two DC gear motors from the ESP32's 3.3 V logic.
Measures distance to the obstacle in front.
parts.electrical_note: ECHO outputs 5 V. Use a 1k/2k divider (or level shifter) before the ESP32 pin.

parts.purpose: Detects a side obstacle / line edge for simple steering correction.

parts.part: 2WD acrylic chassis with 2 gear motors and wheels

parts.purpose: Optional scanner mount for the ultrasonic sensor.
parts.electrical_note: Draws current spikes; power from the 5 V rail, never from a GPIO.

parts.purpose: Powers motors and the ESP32 through the L298N regulator.
